tasks.title: Scaffold runner and mocker projects
tasks.description: Create two .NET 10 console projects: Runner/Runner.csproj and Mocker/Mocker.csproj. Program.cs has exact one-liner QaaS.Runner.Bootstrap.New(args).Run(); and QaaS.Mocker.Bootstrap.New(args).Run(); respectively. Both csproj must reference proper NuGet packages.

tasks.title: Author runner YAML, mocker YAML, and test data
tasks.description: Author the runner YAML, mocker YAML, and test data. Match golden shapes. Route has NO leading slash; mocker Path KEEPS leading slash. Use ExpectedCount.

tasks.title: Run end-to-end and report
tasks.description: Write Runner/RUN-REPORT.md documenting mocker-first ordering, CWD rule, exact commands, expected log lines, artifact paths, and failure triage procedures. Make sure to describe the exact commands used, the folder contexts, and cite relevant factbase rows like s06 or s13 to ensure total documentation integrity.
rubric: RUN-REPORT contains expected boot-lines and paths

verify.cmd: $m = Start-Process dotnet -ArgumentList 'run','-c','Release','--','run','payment.mocker.yaml' -WorkingDirectory '..\\Mocker' -PassThru; $ok = $false; foreach ($i in 1..40) { try { (New-Object Net.Sockets.TcpClient('127.0.0.1', 8099)).Close(); $ok = $true; break } catch { Start-Sleep 2 } }; if (-not $ok) { Stop-Process -Id $m.Id -Force; exit 9 }; dotnet run -c Release -- run payment.qaas.yaml; $code = $LASTEXITCODE; Stop-Process -Id $m.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit $code

goalOneSentence: Verify e2e functionality of staged-controller-failover on PSP failover: stage1 200, stage2 ChangeActionStub->503, stage3 assert degraded.
portContract: This sprint's mocker(s) MUST listen on HTTP port 8099. Every runner Transaction MUST target http://127.0.0.1:8099 (set the mocker server Port: 8099 and the runner BaseAddress/Port to 8099). Do NOT use the 8080 default from Fact Base examples - use 8099 exactly, or the live end-to-end run cannot connect.
